SELECT 'lines' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ds, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, MIN(CAST(dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE)), MAX(CAST(dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE)) FROM fact_web_order

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type IS NULL AS no_order, COUNT(*) n, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-25' AND (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3,4) OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS ret
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS web_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.ret),2) AS refunds,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rnk
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND n.business_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 14

WITH wd AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
s AS (SELECT f.net_amount, f.product_key, p.category, wd.dd FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key AND st.store_id=900
      JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE wd.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'),
r AS (SELECT r.refund_net, p.category FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key AND st.store_id=900 LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
      WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT 'sales_all' k, SUM(net_amount) v, COUNT(*) n FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_no_product', SUM(net_amount), COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE category IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_zz', SUM(net_amount), COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_all', SUM(refund_net), COUNT(*) FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_zz', SUM(refund_net), COUNT(*) FROM r WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt_store900_before_ret', SUM(net_sales_before_returns), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt_store900_ret', SUM(returns_net), 0 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
